mask.conversion: keep = source_alpha < 128; nearest resize to target; crop panel; drop RGB is black

output_semantics: One shared-backbone inference. NMS-free xyxy/score/class; gun classes0..7 and optic classes8..12. Input padded y96.
limitations: New v5 recording is1024x576, resized using cv2.INTER_LINEAR to1920x1080 before the unchanged ROI and mask; upsampling adds no source detail.
New v5 holdout uses separated temporal episodes from the same recording/gameplay, not an independent recording or new match.
Only ALTERNATOR none, LSTAR none/three_x, PROWLER two_x and CAR two_x were user-confirmed; unseen optic states remain unverified.
Nemesis retains five training frames from one short four_x scene; other optics and independent generalization remain unverified.
Old R99 none and user-confirmed one_x samples remain unchanged.
Old Kraber exclusion is retained: no Kraber training or negative samples. Threshold rejection cannot guarantee rejection of every unseen gun.
Old234 transformed samples and old v4 holdout19 are development regression, not independent accuracy.
New v5 offline correctness requires correct gun/optic plus accepted optic center errors strictly below14px in both axes; this is an evaluation rule, not a new runtime threshold.
v6 adds a 1920x1080 30fps 111-second edited recording: R99 one_x, ALTERNATOR one_x, R301 two_x/three_x/four_x. No OCR is used. User corrected the initial R99 identity.

v6 has104 new training,27 new validation and63 held-out frames (60 weapon-positive,3 no-HUD negative). All selected frames visually reviewed before training; prior v5 holdout now development regression.
New v6 holdout comes from separated temporal episodes/blocks of the same edited recording, not independent-match accuracy. Very small R99 and ALTERNATOR holdout subgroups.
Runtime ROI, binary mask, class order, 320x320 input, shared backbone, output shape and confidence thresholds remain unchanged.

joint_detector.four_x_policy: Includes 2-4x adjustable optic regardless of current zoom
joint_detector.r99_policy: Only none and one_x; reject unsupported winning class, no fallback
